text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 8) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 8 April 2022.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan kenderaan di bawah kelas kenderaan yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (2) Jadual Pertama, di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (1) Jadual Pertama sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua,

berkuat kuasa pada 8 April 2022, dilarang.

Pengecualian

3. Pengecualian daripada larangan itu hendaklah diberikan bagi maksud dan dalam

hal keadaan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 8) ORDER 2022

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 183/2022 published on 25 March 2022, notice was given of the

intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Senior Minister of Works against

the making of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Senior Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to in

subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use of

Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 8) Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 8 April 2022.

Prohibition

2. The driving of vehicles under the classes of vehicles specified in column (2) of the

First Schedule, on the part of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule as

shown on the map in the Second Schedule, with effect from 8 April 2022, is prohibited.

Exemption

3. Exemption from such prohibition shall be given for the purposes and in

circumstances specified in the Third Schedule.
